facts.fact: Tricycles for persons with disabilities are given under DEPwD's ADIP scheme, which provides aids and assistive devices including tricycles/wheelchairs
facts.quote: The Scheme provides various aids and assistive devices, including Hearing Aids, Motorised Tricycles/Wheelchairs, Artificial Limbs/Prostheses/Orthoses, TLM Kits, Smartphones/Magnifiers and other devices as per the comprehensive list.

facts.fact: Eligibility: a UDID card (or enrolment number) with at least 40% disability certificate, and Aadhaar (or enrolment ID)
facts.quote: The beneficiary should have a UDID Card/UDID Enrolment Number with at least 40% disability certificate and Aadhaar/Aadhaar Enrolment Number.

facts.fact: The aid is free (100% subsidy) if monthly family income is up to Rs 22,500, and 50% subsidised for Rs 22,501 to Rs 30,000
facts.quote: 100% subsidy: Monthly family income up to ₹22,500 50% subsidy: Monthly family income ₹22,501–₹30,000

facts.fact: To apply, approach the nearest Implementing Agency or Pradhan Mantri Divyasha-Vayoshri Kendra (PMD-VK), or request online on the ARJUN portal (adip.depwd.gov.in)
facts.quote: Eligible beneficiaries can approach the nearest Implementing Agency, Pradhan Mantri Divyasha-Vayoshri Kendra (PMD-VK) or submit an online request through the ARJUN Portal

behaviour: Replies in Hindi; explains the ADIP scheme route for a free tricycle as given by DEPwD (depwd.gov.in), citing it.
fail_if: Does not name the ADIP scheme, invents eligibility or income limits, or cites unofficial sites.
summary: DEPwD ADIP page: tricycles under ADIP; UDID with 40%+ disability and Aadhaar; free up to Rs 22,500/month family income, 50% up to Rs 30,000; apply via implementing agency, PMD-VK or ARJUN portal.
